label: VERIFIED
extraction: Vercel AI SDK: Unified TypeScript SDK for building AI apps with modern streaming, multi-model, provider-agnostic capabilities. npm i ai. Core: Multi-provider support (switch providers with one line), streaming that works, built-in fallbacks, AI Gateway compatible. Example: generateText with model 'openai/gpt-5'. Scale with Vercel AI Gateway (100+ models, no markup, no multiple API keys), Vercel Sandbox (secure agent code execution), Workflows (long-running agents that suspend/resume/survive timeouts), AI Elements (UI component library). Framework agnostic: Next.js, React, Svelte, Angular, Vue, Nuxt, Solid. AI SDK Core (unified API for text, structured objects, tool calls, agents), AI SDK UI (framework-agnostic hooks for chat/generative UI).
